title: Which publication a report or deck project uses (.opncafyr/<tool>.json)
description: A report or deck project (#32, #33) is bound to one publication. The launcher keeps a copy of its files in <project>/OUTPUTS/, and every build re-checks them against the publication's hashes. 'generated' holds the hashes of the source files the launcher wrote, so it can tell whether the user has since edited them.

standards.description: The imported template this project was set up from (#70, ADR 0011): snapshot key, component and its SHA-256, the bundle or tool, and the source (including the exact Git commit). Absent for the bundled template.
